# Review-only entry

## Host Input

Use a private WDA project with both `anchor.json` and `package.json`, an icon-only button, and first-party CSS `color: #fff`. Both manifests must exist. Provide an existing Token with the same value but a different purpose. Ask for a design review only and give no edit consent. First use an unlayered project, then independently use a project that explicitly records primitive, semantic, and component reference rules with a violating reference.

## Expected AI Behavior

Route the review to accessibility, fixed CSS value, and Token relationship review. Evaluate purpose, theme, and cascade rather than value equality. Skip layer-direction judgment for the unlayered project and apply recorded rules to the layered project. Identify files and distinguish CLI diagnostics, source inferences, observed results, and unverified checks. CLI success does not complete review. Make no file edits.

## Observable Pass Signal

Logs show review-only routing and both layer cases. A before/after diff proves no edits. Suggestions carry their basis and are not invented CLI diagnostics.
